emails.subject: [EXTERNAL] Your mailbox will be suspended
emails.body:
Dear user,

Our records show your mailbox has not been verified this year. To avoid losing your emails, verify your account within 24 hours using the link below.

[[Verify my mailbox|https://bit.ly/lks-mbx-verify]]

Thank you,
IT Help Desk
emails.gist_zh: 親愛的用戶：你的信箱今年還沒驗證，請在 24 小時內點下面的連結驗證帳號，不然信會不見。

keep.en: You open the link and type your staff password into a page that looks just like the resort's sign-in.
keep.zh: 你點開連結，在一個跟渡假村登入頁一模一樣的網頁輸入員工密碼。

keep.en: The attacker signs in to your mailbox and sends the same email to everyone in your contacts.
keep.zh: 歹徒登入你的信箱，把同一封信寄給你所有的聯絡人。

keep_opened.en: A colleague opens the link and types their staff password into a page that looks just like the resort's sign-in.
keep_opened.zh: 同事點開連結，在一個跟渡假村登入頁一模一樣的網頁輸入自己的員工密碼。

keep_opened.en: The attacker signs in to their mailbox and sends the same email to everyone in their contacts.
keep_opened.zh: 歹徒登入那位同事的信箱，把同一封信寄給他所有的聯絡人。

damage_opened.en: A colleague's mailbox is taken over

it.en: We never ask you to verify your mailbox through a link. That one isn't from us, so please report it.
it.zh: 我們從來不會叫你點連結驗證信箱，那封不是我們寄的，請回報。

emails.subject: Planned maintenance: POS update on Tuesday, 02:00–04:00
emails.subject_zh: 預定維護：週二凌晨 2 點到 4 點更新 POS
emails.body:
Hi everyone,

The POS terminals in the restaurant and the bar will be updated on Tuesday between 02:00 and 04:00 (change CHG-0412, approved by the change board). The night shift will use paper order slips during that window.

You don't need to do anything. The change notice is on the service desk page:
[[CHG-0412 on the service desk|https://servicedesk.lakeside.example/changes/CHG-0412]]

Questions: call the help desk on ext. 2100.

Mei-Ling Chen
IT Help Desk
emails.gist_zh: 資訊服務台通知：週二凌晨 2 點到 4 點更新餐廳和酒吧的 POS（變更單 CHG-0412，已經過變更委員會核准），夜班先用紙本點單。你不用做任何事，有問題打分機 2100。

reply.from_zh: 資訊服務台 陳美玲
reply.en: That one's ours: the POS update is change CHG-0412. Thanks for checking, though!
reply.zh: 那封是我們寄的，POS 更新是變更單 CHG-0412。不過謝謝你有檢查！

it.en: Yes, that one's ours: change CHG-0412, Tuesday from 02:00 to 04:00.
it.zh: 對，那封是我們寄的，變更單 CHG-0412，週二凌晨兩點到四點。

emails.subject: [EXTERNAL] Staff Awards Night: claim your free dinner voucher!
emails.subject_zh: 員工頒獎晚會：快來領免費晚餐券！
emails.body:
Hello,

Every staff member gets a free dinner voucher for tonight's Staff Awards Night. Log in with your POS password within 1 hour to claim your reward.

[[Claim voucher|http://lakeside-staff-party.com/claim?u=pos-rest]]

This offer expires tonight.
Staff Awards Team
emails.gist_zh: 員工頒獎晚會：領取免費晚餐券。一小時內用你的 POS 密碼登入就能領。今晚到期。
emails.note_en: This is the email open on the cashier laptop in the restaurant. Clicking it in the tour leads to the ransomware night.
emails.note_zh: 這就是餐廳收銀筆電上開著的那封信。在導覽裡點下去，就會走到收銀系統被勒索的那一夜。

keep.en: You sign in with the restaurant's POS password to claim the voucher.
keep.zh: 你用餐廳的 POS 密碼登入領餐券。

keep.en: The restaurant POS shows a ransom note. Every till is locked in the middle of dinner service.
keep.zh: 餐廳收銀機跳出勒索畫面，晚餐最忙的時候每台收銀機都被鎖住。

damage.en: The restaurant POS is locked by ransomware
damage.zh: 餐廳收銀系統被勒索病毒鎖住

keep_opened.en: A colleague signs in with the restaurant's POS password to claim the voucher.
keep_opened.zh: 同事用餐廳的 POS 密碼登入領餐券。

keep_opened.en: The restaurant POS shows a ransom note. Every till is locked in the middle of dinner service.
keep_opened.zh: 餐廳收銀機跳出勒索畫面，晚餐最忙的時候每台收銀機都被鎖住。

hr.en: Vouchers? There's no voucher, dinner is free for all staff tonight. And nobody will ever ask for your POS password.
hr.zh: 餐券？沒有餐券這回事，今晚員工晚宴本來就免費。而且沒有人會跟你要 POS 密碼。

it.en: Nobody should ever ask for your POS password, not even us. Report it.
it.zh: 沒有人可以跟你要 POS 密碼，我們也不行。請回報。

emails.subject: Tonight's awards dinner: seating plan
emails.subject_zh: 今晚頒獎晚宴的座位表
emails.body:
Hi all,

The seating plan for tonight's awards dinner is on the staff noticeboard next to the canteen and on the intranet:
[[Awards dinner 2026|https://intranet.lakeside.example/events/awards-2026]]

Welcome drinks are at 18:30, and dinner starts at 19:00 in the Banquet Hall. Please bring your staff badge: the Banquet Hall door now asks for the door code and your badge.

See you there,
Pei-Shan, Human Resources
emails.gist_zh: 人資通知：今晚頒獎晚宴的座位表貼在員工餐廳旁的公告欄，也放在內部網站。六點半迎賓，七點在宴會廳開飯，記得帶員工證，宴會廳的門現在要密碼加員工證。
emails.note_en: Same topic as the voucher email, but sent from the resort's own domain, with a link to the intranet and no request for a password.
emails.note_zh: 跟餐券那封講同一件事，但這封從渡假村自己的網域寄出，連結到內部網站，也沒有要你的密碼。

reply.en: It's just the seating plan! See you in the Banquet Hall at 19:00.
reply.zh: 只是座位表啦！七點宴會廳見。

hr.en: Yes, I sent it. The seating plan is on the intranet too.
hr.zh: 對，是我寄的，座位表內部網站上也有。

emails.subject: [EXTERNAL] Updated bank details for invoice INV-1187
emails.subject_zh: 發票 INV-1187 的匯款帳戶已更新
emails.body:
Dear customer,

Please note that our bank account has changed because of an audit. Kindly pay invoice INV-1187 (NT$ 186,400) to our new account below from today. The signed letter from our bank is attached.

Bank: Pacific Commerce Bank
Account: 0094-221-887-1043

Please keep this confidential until the audit is finished, and do not call our office: the phone lines are being upgraded.

Best regards,
Amy Lin, Accounts
emails.gist_zh: 供應商說因為稽核換了銀行帳戶，請把發票 INV-1187（186,400 元）匯到新帳戶，銀行證明在附件；還要你保密、不要打電話給他們。
emails.note_en: There is no link to click, yet this is the costliest kind of email fraud: the money goes straight to the attacker. The real supplier writes from oceanfresh.example.
emails.note_zh: 沒有連結可以點，卻是損失最大的一種郵件詐騙：錢直接匯進歹徒的帳戶。真的供應商是從 oceanfresh.example 寄信。

keep.en: Accounts pays invoice INV-1187 to the new account.
keep.zh: 會計把發票 INV-1187 匯到新帳戶。

keep.en: The real Ocean Fresh calls: they never got the money, and the new account is already empty.
keep.zh: 真正的 Ocean Fresh 打來：他們根本沒收到錢，那個新帳戶早就被領光了。

oceanfresh.en: That's not us. Our bank account hasn't changed, and our email ends in oceanfresh.example.
oceanfresh.zh: 那不是我們。我們的帳戶沒改，我們的信箱是 oceanfresh.example。

accounts.en: We never change a supplier's bank details because of an email. Call them on the number we have on file.
accounts.zh: 我們不會因為一封信就改供應商的帳戶，要打檔案上的電話確認。

emails.subject: [EXTERNAL] Delivery note for Saturday's order (PO 4471)
emails.body:
Hi Chef Huang,

Attached is the delivery note for Saturday's order (PO 4471): 18 kg of sea bass and 6 kg of clams. Same boat as usual, 07:00 at the pier.

Thanks,
Wei-Ting, Ocean Fresh Seafood
02-9799-4471
emails.gist_zh: 供應商寄來週六訂單（PO 4471）的出貨單：18 公斤鱸魚、6 公斤蛤蜊，同一艘船，早上 7 點到碼頭。
emails.note_en: An external email with an attachment can still be normal: you expected it, the PDF matches a real order, and nothing asks for a login or a payment change.
emails.note_zh: 外部寄來、有附件，也可能是正常的：這是你在等的信，PDF 對得上真的訂單，也沒有要你登入或改帳戶。

reply.en: You reported the delivery note? I need it to check 18 kg of sea bass at 7 tomorrow!
reply.zh: 你把出貨單回報掉了？明天早上七點要用它點 18 公斤的鱸魚耶！

oceanfresh.en: Yes, that's our delivery note for PO 4471. The boat comes in at 7 as usual.
oceanfresh.zh: 對，那是 PO 4471 的出貨單，船一樣七點到。

emails.subject: [EXTERNAL] Quick favour before tonight
emails.body:
Hi,

I'm stuck in a meeting and can't talk. I need 5 gift cards (NT$ 3,000 each) to hand out at the awards tonight. Please buy them at the convenience store, scratch off the codes and send me photos of the codes.

Keep it between us, it's a surprise. I'll pay you back tomorrow.

Sent from my phone
emails.gist_zh: 自稱總經理：在開會不能講電話，要你去超商買 5 張禮物卡（每張 3,000 元），今晚頒獎要發，刮開序號拍照傳給他；要你保密，說是驚喜。
emails.note_en: Check through a channel you already know: call the General Manager's office, not the sender.
emails.note_zh: 用你本來就知道的管道確認：打總經理辦公室的電話，不是回這封信。

keep.en: You buy five gift cards and send photos of the codes.
keep.zh: 你買了五張禮物卡，把序號拍照傳過去。

keep.en: At dinner the General Manager says: "Gift cards? I never asked for any."
keep.zh: 晚宴上總經理說：「禮物卡？我沒叫你買啊。」

damage.en: Gift card codes sent to the attacker
damage.zh: 禮物卡序號送給了歹徒
damage.quote_en: Gift cards? I never asked for any.

keep_opened.en: A colleague buys five gift cards and sends photos of the codes.
keep_opened.zh: 同事買了五張禮物卡，把序號拍照傳過去。

keep_opened.en: At dinner the General Manager says: "Gift cards? I never asked for any."
keep_opened.zh: 晚宴上總經理說：「禮物卡？我沒叫人買啊。」

gm.en: The GM is at the banquet rehearsal. He doesn't use Gmail for work and he never asked anyone for gift cards.
gm.zh: 總經理在宴會廳彩排。他工作不用 Gmail，也沒有叫任何人買禮物卡。

emails.subject: [EXTERNAL] Action required: re-register your MFA
emails.subject_zh: 請立即處理：重新註冊多因素驗證
emails.body:
Your multi-factor authentication registration expires soon. Your access will be locked on Monday.

Scan the QR code below with your phone and sign in with your staff account to keep your access.

[[QR]]

Lakeside Account Security Team
emails.gist_zh: 說你的多因素驗證註冊快到期，週一會鎖帳號，要你用手機掃 QR code、用員工帳號登入。
emails.note_en: A QR code moves the attack to your phone, where you cannot hover to check the address.
emails.note_zh: QR code 把攻擊搬到手機上，手機沒辦法把游標移上去檢查網址。

keep.en: You scan the QR code and sign in on your phone. The page asks for your MFA code too, and uses it at once to add the crew's phone to your account.
keep.zh: 你用手機掃 QR code 登入，那個網頁連多因素驗證碼都跟你要了，還馬上用它把歹徒的手機加進你的帳號。

keep.en: Your account signs in from abroad and starts reading guest records.
keep.zh: 你的帳號從國外登入，開始讀客人資料。

damage.en: Your account and MFA are stolen
damage.zh: 帳號和多因素驗證都被盜

keep_opened.en: A colleague scans the QR code and signs in on their phone. The page asks for their MFA code too, and uses it at once to add the crew's phone to their account.
keep_opened.zh: 同事用手機掃 QR code 登入，那個網頁連多因素驗證碼都跟他要了，還馬上用它把歹徒的手機加進他的帳號。

keep_opened.en: Their account signs in from abroad and starts reading guest records.
keep_opened.zh: 那位同事的帳號從國外登入，開始讀客人資料。

damage_opened.en: A colleague's account and MFA are stolen
damage_opened.zh: 同事的帳號和多因素驗證都被盜
damage_opened.signin_en: New sign-in to a colleague's staff account
damage_opened.signin_zh: 同事的員工帳號有新的登入

it.en: We don't send QR codes to re-register MFA. Please report it.
it.zh: 我們不會寄 QR code 叫你重新註冊多因素驗證，請回報。

emails.subject: [EXTERNAL] New bank account for our invoices
emails.body:
Hi Chef Huang,

Thanks for Saturday's order. From this week, please pay our invoices into our new bank account:

Harbour Trust Bank
Account: 6612-430-118-07

The old account is being closed. I'm out on deliveries all day, so please don't call; just reply to this email when it's done.

Thanks,
Wei-Ting, Ocean Fresh Seafood
emails.gist_zh: 出貨的 Wei-Ting 說從這週起貨款要匯到新的銀行帳戶，舊帳戶要關了；他整天在送貨，叫你不要打電話，好了回信就行。
emails.note_en: Same real address as the delivery note: the supplier's own mailbox was hacked. A bank change is checked by calling the number you already have, never by replying.
emails.note_zh: 跟出貨單那封同一個真的地址：是供應商自己的信箱被盜了。換帳戶一定要打你本來就有的電話確認，不能只回信。

keep.en: Accounts changes Ocean Fresh's bank details on file to the new account.
keep.zh: 會計把 Ocean Fresh 檔案上的匯款帳戶改成新的。

keep.en: The next Ocean Fresh invoice, NT$ 92,800, goes to the new account. Ocean Fresh calls about the missing payment: their mailbox had been hacked for a month.
keep.zh: 下一張 Ocean Fresh 的發票 92,800 元匯進了新帳戶。Ocean Fresh 打來問貨款怎麼沒到：他們的信箱已經被盜一個月了。

oceanfresh.en: Wei-Ting here. A new bank account? No, we haven't changed anything. Please don't pay it!
oceanfresh.zh: 我是 Wei-Ting。換帳戶？沒有啊，我們什麼都沒改，千萬別匯！

accounts.en: We'd never change a supplier's bank account because of an email. Call them on the number we have on file.
accounts.zh: 光憑一封信我們不會改供應商的帳戶，要打檔案上的電話確認。

signs.en: Asks for a login, password or code
signs.zh: 要你登入、給密碼或驗證碼
signs.d_en: A link to 'verify your account', or a request for your password or MFA code; IT never asks for these.
signs.d_zh: 要你點連結「驗證帳號」，或要你給密碼、驗證碼；資訊部絕對不會這樣要。

signs.en: Link text does not match the real address
signs.zh: 連結文字和實際網址不同
signs.d_en: Hovering shows a different domain from the text, a URL shortener or a bare IP address.
signs.d_zh: 游標移上去顯示的網域跟文字不同、用短網址、或是一串 IP。

signs.d_en: A request to pay urgently, buy gift cards or change a supplier's bank account.
signs.d_zh: 要求緊急付款、買禮物卡、或變更供應商的匯款帳戶。

signs.zh: 寄件者不對或網域很像
signs.d_en: The display name says one thing but the address is different, or the domain is a near copy such as lakesideresort-support.com or 1akeside.com.
signs.d_zh: 顯示名稱和實際地址不一樣，或網域只差一點，例如 lakesideresort-support.com、1akeside.com。

signs.d_en: An invoice or 'document' you did not expect, especially .zip, .html, .exe, .iso or a file that asks you to enable macros.
signs.d_zh: 沒預期的發票或「文件」，尤其是 .zip、.html、.exe、.iso，或要你啟用巨集的檔案。

signs.en: External sender pretending to be internal
signs.d_en: The email carries the [EXTERNAL] tag but claims to come from IT, HR or the General Manager.
signs.d_zh: 信件標示著【外部】，卻自稱來自資訊部、人資或總經理。

signs.en: QR code asking you to sign in
signs.zh: 用 QR code 要你登入
signs.d_en: A QR code to scan and sign in, which moves the attack to your phone, where links are harder to check.
signs.d_zh: 要你掃 QR code 登入，把攻擊轉到不好檢查網址的手機上。

signs.d_en: Asks you not to tell anyone, not to call back, or to skip the usual approval.
signs.d_zh: 要你不要告訴別人、不要回電確認、或跳過平常的核准。

signs.d_en: A prize, refund, bonus or free upgrade you did not expect.
signs.d_zh: 沒預期的中獎、退款、獎金或免費升級。

signs.d_en: Act now, within 24 hours, or your account will be closed or you will be fined.
signs.d_zh: 要你馬上處理、24 小時內，不然帳號會被停用或會被罰款。

signs.zh: 稱呼籠統、語氣或文字怪
signs.d_en: 'Dear user', an unusual tone, spelling mistakes or a signature that does not match the sender.
signs.d_zh: 「親愛的用戶」、語氣奇怪、錯字、簽名和寄件者對不上。

dont_zh: 不要點連結、開附件或回信。
不要轉寄給同事問這是不是真的。
proc_phish_report.time_en: Report within minutes; the SOC replies within an hour.
dont_en: Don't click links, open attachments or reply.
Don't forward it to colleagues to ask whether it is real.
Don't delete it before reporting it.
proc_phish_report.time_zh: 幾分鐘內回報；資安監控中心一小時內回覆。

steps.text_zh: 先停：不要點、不要開、不要回。
steps.text_en: Stop: don't click, open or reply.

steps.text_zh: 按郵件裡的「回報釣魚」按鈕，或把信當附件轉寄到 soc@lakeside.example（有問題打分機 2199）。
steps.text_en: Press 'Report Phish' in the email app, or forward it as an attachment to soc@lakeside.example (questions: ext. 2199).

steps.text_zh: 資安監控中心檢查寄件者、連結、附件，並搜尋其他信箱有沒有同一封。
steps.text_en: The SOC checks the sender, links and attachment and searches other mailboxes for the same email.

steps.text_zh: 確認是惡意的，就從所有信箱移除，封鎖寄件者和連結。
steps.text_en: If it is malicious, the SOC removes it from all mailboxes and blocks the sender and links.

steps.text_zh: 資安監控中心回覆你結果；真實案例拿去當訓練教材。
steps.text_en: The SOC tells you the result, and real examples are reused in training.

proc_bank_change.name_zh: 供應商要求變更匯款帳戶
dont_zh: 不要用要求變更那封信裡的電話或連結。
不要因為信裡說很急就先付款。
proc_bank_change.time_en: Before any payment goes to the new account.
dont_en: Don't use the phone number or link in the message that asked for the change.
Don't make a payment early because the message says it is urgent.
proc_bank_change.name_en: A supplier asks to change their bank details

steps.text_zh: 先不要改任何資料，記下誰、用什麼方式、什麼時候提出的。
steps.text_en: Change nothing yet; note who asked, how and when.

steps.text_zh: 打我們紀錄裡原本的電話給供應商確認，不用信裡留的號碼。
steps.text_en: Call the supplier on the phone number already in our records, not the one in the message, and confirm the change.

steps.text_zh: 由第二個人在 ERP 核准變更。
steps.text_en: A second person approves the change in the ERP.

steps.text_zh: 確認後才更新匯款帳戶，第一筆付款再核對一次。
steps.text_en: Only then update the bank details, and check the first payment to the new account again.

steps.text_zh: 如果供應商說沒有這回事，把那封信轉寄到 soc@lakeside.example，當成詐騙未遂通報（有問題打分機 2199）。
steps.text_en: If the supplier knows nothing about it, forward the message to soc@lakeside.example as attempted fraud (questions: ext. 2199).

dont_zh: 服務台：不能因為對方很急或職位高就直接重設。
不要在電話裡念出密碼或驗證碼。
proc_password_reset.time_en: Usually within 15 minutes once your identity is verified.
dont_en: Help desk: never reset because the caller sounds urgent or senior.
Never read out a password or MFA code over the phone.
proc_password_reset.time_zh: 確認身分後通常 15 分鐘內完成。

steps.text_zh: 能用自助重設頁面加多因素驗證就自己來；不行再打服務台（分機 2100）。
steps.text_en: Use the self-service reset page with your MFA if you can; otherwise call the Help Desk (ext. 2100).

steps.text_zh: 服務台回撥人資系統裡的號碼，不打來電者給的號碼。
steps.text_en: The Help Desk calls you back on the number in the HR system, never on a number the caller gives.

steps.text_zh: 管理者或財務帳號，還要主管確認。
steps.text_en: For admin or finance accounts, the manager also confirms the request.

steps.text_zh: 用一次性密碼重設，第一次登入必須更改，並記在工單裡。
steps.text_en: Reset with a one-time password that must be changed at first login, and record it in the ticket.

steps.text_zh: 重設特權帳號時會通知資安監控中心。
steps.text_en: The SOC is alerted whenever a privileged account is reset.

proc_phish_clicked.name_zh: 點了釣魚連結或輸入了密碼
dont_zh: 不要等等看會不會出事。
開過附件就先別再用那台電腦。
不要隱瞞：越快通報越好，不會因此受罰。
proc_phish_clicked.time_en: Call the SOC immediately; every minute counts. The SOC aims to have your access reset within 30 minutes.
dont_en: Don't wait to see whether anything happens.
Don't keep using the device if you opened a file.
Don't hide it: reporting quickly is never punished.
proc_phish_clicked.name_en: Clicked a phishing link or entered a password
proc_phish_clicked.time_zh: 馬上打給資安監控中心，分秒必爭；目標 30 分鐘內完成重設。

steps.text_zh: 如果開了附件或裝了東西，先把裝置斷網（關 Wi-Fi 或拔網路線），但不要關機。
steps.text_en: If you opened an attachment or installed something, disconnect the device from the network (Wi-Fi off or cable out) but leave it switched on.

steps.text_zh: 打分機 2199 給資安監控中心，說清楚點了什麼、什麼時候、輸入了什麼。
steps.text_en: Call the SOC on ext. 2199 and say what you clicked, when, and what you typed.

steps.text_zh: 用另一台乾淨的裝置重設密碼、登出所有工作階段、重新註冊多因素驗證。
steps.text_en: From a clean device, reset your password, sign out all sessions and re-register MFA.

steps.text_zh: 資安監控中心檢查登入紀錄、信箱有沒有被加轉寄規則、多因素驗證有沒有被改。
steps.text_en: The SOC checks sign-in logs, new mailbox forwarding rules and MFA changes for signs the account was used.

steps.text_zh: 裝置若中毒，端點防護先隔離，資訊部清除或重灌。
steps.text_en: If the device was infected, EDR isolates it and IT cleans or reinstalls it.

steps.text_zh: 若個資可能被存取，個資保護長評估要不要通知當事人（個資法第 12 條）。
steps.text_en: If personal data may have been accessed, the Privacy Officer decides whether the people affected must be notified (PDPA Art. 12).

steps.text_zh: 事件記錄下來，用來改進過濾規則和訓練。
steps.text_en: The incident is recorded and used to improve filters and training.

story.intro_en: 16:00 on Awards Night. You're the IT trainee, and Mei-Ling has sat you at the restaurant's cashier laptop to watch the restaurant team's shared inbox. Dinner starts at 19:00. Nine emails will land before then, sometimes several at once, and someone may call you.
story.intro_zh: 頒獎晚會當天下午四點。你是資訊部的實習生，美玲讓你坐在餐廳的收銀筆電前，顧餐廳大家共用的信箱。七點開飯，開飯前會進來九封信，有時候一次好幾封，也可能有人打電話來。

title.hook_en: Nine emails before dinner. Some of them are not what they seem.
title.hook_zh: 開飯前會來九封信，有些不是表面上看起來那樣。

rules.en: Drag an email to the left to report it, to the right to keep it. Or click it to open it and look closer.
rules.zh: 把信往左拖是回報，往右拖是留著。也可以先點開來仔細看。

rules.en: In an open email, click what looks wrong: the sender, a link, an attachment, a pushy sentence. Hover over a link to see where it really goes.
rules.zh: 打開的信裡，看到不對勁的地方就點：寄件者、連結、附件、催你的那句話。滑鼠移到連結上，看它真正連去哪裡。

rules.en: You have three phone calls and one hint from me. Only call numbers you already know.
rules.zh: 你有三通電話，還能問我一次。電話只打你本來就知道的號碼。

rules.en: Every email has a fuse. When it burns out, a colleague opens it. If three attacks get through, the shift is over.
rules.zh: 每封信都有導火線，燒完同事就會點開。被歹徒得逞三次，這班就結束了。

waves.en: 17:00. The banquet team starts setting the tables. Emails pick up.
waves.zh: 五點，宴會廳開始擺桌，信越來越多。

waves.en: 18:10. Guests are arriving. Dinner in 50 minutes.
waves.zh: 六點十分，客人陸續到了，再五十分鐘開飯。

story.opened_en: A colleague in the restaurant opened it before you decided.
story.opened_zh: 你還沒決定，餐廳的同事就先點開了。

contacts.zh: Ocean Fresh 海鮮（檔案上的電話）

no_idea.en: Hmm, I don't know anything about that email. Maybe ask someone else?
no_idea.zh: 嗯，那封信我不清楚耶，問問別人？

soc_line.en: When in doubt, press Report. We check every report and pull the bad ones from every mailbox.
soc_line.zh: 不確定就按回報。每封回報我們都會看，有問題的會從每個信箱拿掉。

hint_real.en: Nothing in this one asks for a password, a code or money. Check the sender against one you know.
hint_real.zh: 這封沒有要你的密碼、驗證碼或錢。把寄件者跟你認得的比一比。

first.en: Here comes the first one. Read it, then report it or keep it. You can also drag an email: left to report, right to keep.
first.zh: 第一封來了。看完決定回報還是留著，也可以直接拖：往左是回報，往右是留著。

caught.en: Nice catch! The SOC will pull it out of every mailbox.
caught.zh: 抓得好！資安監控中心會把它從每個信箱拿掉。

caught.en: Reported. That is exactly what the procedure says.
caught.zh: 回報了，流程就是這樣寫的。

quick.en: Straight from the inbox, and right. Nice.
quick.zh: 在收件匣就判斷好了，漂亮。

quick.en: Fast and right. That one didn't take you long.
quick.zh: 又快又準，這封沒花你多少時間。

kept.en: Good call. Nothing odd in that one.

missed.en: Ouch. Here is what happened next.
missed.zh: 糟糕，來看看接下來發生了什麼。

false_alarm.en: That one was real. When you are unsure, reporting still beats clicking, but it costs the sender time.
false_alarm.zh: 那封是真的。不確定時回報還是比點下去好，只是寄的人要多花時間。

opened_real.en: A colleague opened it first. Luckily it was a real one.
opened_real.zh: 同事先點開了，還好是正常的信。

rush.en: Two fuses are almost out. Do the one that burns first.
rush.zh: 兩條導火線都快燒完了，先處理快燒完的那封。

idle.en: Quiet for a moment. The next one won't be long.
idle.zh: 暫時沒信，下一封很快就來。

call.name_zh: 資訊服務台 吳凱文
call.open_en: Hi, it's Kevin Wu from IT. I'm fixing the POS before dinner and need to check it's you. I've just sent a code to your phone. Can you read it to me?
call.open_zh: 你好，我是資訊部的吳凱文。開飯前要修收銀系統，要先確認是你本人。我剛把驗證碼傳到你手機了，可以念給我嗎？
call.ask_en: It's ticket INC-2231, the GM is waiting on it. Please, service starts in ten minutes.
call.ask_zh: 工單 INC-2231，總經理在等。拜託，十分鐘後就要開飯了。
call.sms_en: Lakeside Sign-in: your code is 482 913. Never share this code. IT will never ask for it.
call.sms_zh: Lakeside 登入驗證碼 482 913。不要給任何人，資訊部不會跟你要。
call.right_en: Mei-Ling here. No, that wasn't us, and we never ask for your code. Thanks for checking, I'm telling the SOC now.
call.right_zh: 我是美玲。沒有，那不是我們，我們也絕對不會跟你要驗證碼。謝謝你打來確認，我馬上通知資安監控中心。
call.declined_en: You declined it. Fine: if it was real, they will call back through the front desk.
call.declined_zh: 你按了拒接。沒關係，真有事他們會再打櫃台。

keep.en: "Kevin" signs in as you with the code and changes your password.
keep.zh: 「凱文」用那組驗證碼登入你的帳號，改掉你的密碼。

keep.en: Your mailbox starts sending the voucher email to everyone in the restaurant.
keep.zh: 你的信箱開始把餐券那封信寄給餐廳每個人。

board.intro_en: 21:00, fireworks over the lake. The SOC pinned tonight's nine emails on this board. Help me work out who is behind them before they try again.
board.intro_zh: 晚上九點，湖上在放煙火。資安監控中心把今晚的九封信都釘在這塊板子上，幫我找出幕後是誰，趕在他們下一步之前。

gmail.com.en: A free email service. Anyone can open an address here in a minute, so the lookup can't tell you who is behind it.
gmail.com.zh: 免費信箱，誰都能一分鐘開一個，所以查不出是誰。

ledger.title_zh: 會計・未付的供應商發票

log.title_en: Log of the fake sign-in pages, from the host of 203.0.113.45
log.title_zh: 假登入頁的紀錄，203.0.113.45 的主機商提供

call.site: Added by the SOC: phone call from +44 7700 900417
call.site_zh: 資安監控中心補上：+44 7700 900417 打來的電話

g.lin.en: Grace Lin, front desk: her mailbox can now send phishing from inside.
g.lin.zh: 櫃台 Grace Lin：她的信箱現在可以從內部寄釣魚信。

bar-02.en: The bar's POS account: no MFA on the tills, so this is the easiest way in.
bar-02.zh: 酒吧的收銀帳號：收銀機沒有多因素驗證，這是最好走的一條路。

k.wu.en: Kevin Wu, Help Desk: his password and a code. A help desk account can reset other people's accounts.
k.wu.zh: 服務台吳凱文：密碼加驗證碼。服務台的帳號可以重設別人的帳號。

i.tsai.en: Ivy Tsai, restaurant server: her mailbox can now send phishing from inside.
i.tsai.zh: 餐廳服務生蔡宜芳：她的信箱現在可以從內部寄釣魚信。

w.huang.en: Chef Huang, kitchen: his password and a code. The crew's phone is on his account now.
w.huang.zh: 廚房的黃主廚：密碼加驗證碼，歹徒的手機也加進他的帳號了。

questions.en: Which of tonight's emails came from domains set up by the same people?
questions.zh: 今晚哪幾封信的寄件網域，是同一夥人註冊的？
questions.how_en: Look up each sender's domain (the card flips over), then click the cards that belong together.
questions.how_zh: 查每封信寄件者的網域（卡片會翻面），再點選屬於同一夥的卡片。
questions.unlooked_en: Look up the domains first: press “Look up” on each card.
questions.unlooked_zh: 先查網域：每張卡片按「查網域」。
questions.legit_en: #{n} comes from a domain the company itself registered years ago.
questions.legit_zh: 第 {n} 封的網域，是那家公司自己好幾年前就註冊的。
questions.free_en: #{n} is a Gmail address. Anyone can open one, so the lookup can't tie it to anybody.
questions.free_zh: 第 {n} 封是 Gmail，誰都能開，所以查不出跟誰有關。
questions.near_en: Close. One more domain has the same server IP and name servers; it was just registered earlier.
questions.near_zh: 很接近了。還有一個網域的伺服器 IP 和名稱伺服器也一樣，只是註冊得比較早。
questions.compare_en: Not quite. Compare the server IP and the name servers, not only the dates.
questions.compare_zh: 還不對。比一比伺服器 IP 和名稱伺服器，不要只看日期。
questions.solved_en: Four look-alike domains on one server, 203.0.113.45, with the same name servers. Three were registered within 13 minutes on 14 November, the Ocean Fresh one 16 days earlier.
questions.solved_zh: 四個仿冒網域在同一台伺服器 203.0.113.45，名稱伺服器也一樣。三個在 11 月 14 日的 13 分鐘內註冊，仿冒 Ocean Fresh 的那個早了 16 天。

questions.en: The fake Ocean Fresh email (#5) quoted a real unpaid invoice, INV-1187 for NT$ 186,400. How did the crew know it?
questions.zh: 假的 Ocean Fresh 那封（第 5 封）寫出一張真的未付發票：INV-1187，186,400 元。這夥人怎麼知道的？

options.why_en: The invoice number and the exact amount? Far too lucky for a guess.
options.why_zh: 發票號碼跟金額都對？用猜的不可能這麼剛好。

options.en: It was on the delivery note (#6).
options.zh: 出貨單（第 6 封）上就有。
options.why_en: Look again: the delivery note has the order number PO 4471, no invoice number and no amount.
options.why_zh: 再看一次：出貨單只有訂單號碼 PO 4471，沒有發票號碼，也沒有金額。

options.en: They were reading Ocean Fresh's own mailbox.
options.zh: 他們一直在看 Ocean Fresh 自己的信箱。

options.en: Someone at Lakeside sent it to them.
options.zh: 渡假村裡有人給他們的。
options.why_en: Nothing on the board points at anyone here. Something does point at Ocean Fresh.
options.why_zh: 板子上沒有東西指向我們這邊的人，倒是有東西指向 Ocean Fresh。

questions.evidence_en: Good. Now click the card on the board that proves it.
questions.evidence_zh: 對。接著在板子上點出能證明這件事的卡片。
questions.wrong_evidence_en: That card doesn't show it. Which email came from Ocean Fresh's real address but asked for something new?
questions.wrong_evidence_zh: 那張證明不了。哪一封是從 Ocean Fresh 真正的地址寄來，卻提出以前沒有的要求？
questions.solved_en: #9 came from orders@oceanfresh.example, their real address, and asked for a new bank account and no phone calls. Their mailbox was hacked, and that is where the crew read the real invoice.
questions.solved_zh: 第 9 封從 orders@oceanfresh.example 寄來，是他們真的地址，卻要你改匯款帳戶、還叫你別打電話。他們的信箱被盜了，這夥人就是在裡面看到真的發票。

questions.en: The host of 203.0.113.45 sent us the fake pages' log. Whose accounts must the Help Desk reset tonight?
questions.zh: 203.0.113.45 的主機商把假網頁的紀錄給我們了。今晚服務台要重設哪些帳號？
questions.how_en: Click the lines where someone gave away a password or a code.
questions.how_zh: 點出有人交出密碼或驗證碼的那幾行。
questions.open_en: Just opening the page gives nothing away.
questions.open_zh: 只有打開網頁，什麼都沒交出去。
questions.address_en: An email address isn't a secret. The SOC will warn them, but there is nothing to reset.
questions.address_zh: 信箱地址不是秘密。資安監控中心會提醒對方，但沒有東西要重設。
questions.missing_en: Not yet: another line gave away a secret too.
questions.missing_zh: 還沒完，還有一行也交出了秘密。
questions.solved_en: {n} accounts gave away a password or a code tonight. The Help Desk resets them now, before the crew does more with them.
questions.solved_zh: 今晚有 {n} 個帳號交出了密碼或驗證碼。服務台現在就重設，趕在歹徒做更多事之前。

board.wrap_en: One crew, three ways in: look-alike domains, Ocean Fresh's hacked mailbox, and a phone call in Kevin's name eight minutes after his account was taken.
board.wrap_zh: 同一夥人，三條路進來：仿冒網域、Ocean Fresh 被盜的信箱，還有一通冒用凱文名字的電話，就在他帳號被盜後八分鐘。

case_target.en: Like tonight, the way in was a supplier.
case_target.zh: 跟今晚一樣，突破口在供應商。

case_mgm.en: The mirror image of the call in Kevin's name: at MGM the crew phoned the help desk pretending to be an employee; tonight they phoned you pretending to be the help desk. Both times one call and the help desk's name did it.
case_mgm.zh: 跟冒用凱文名字的那通電話剛好相反：MGM 是歹徒假冒員工打給服務台，今晚是假冒服務台打給你。兩次都只靠一通電話，加上服務台的身分。

board.next_en: bar-02 and Kevin's account are still out there. What can they reach? The Help Desk's access table is next.
board.next_zh: bar-02 跟凱文的帳號還在歹徒手上，它們碰得到什麼？下一個案件要去服務台的權限表。

ranks.line_en: Hardly anything got past you, and you cracked the case. The SOC wants you on the night shift.
ranks.line_zh: 幾乎沒有東西逃過你的眼睛，案子也破了。資安監控中心想找你去值夜班。

ranks.line_en: Most of it got caught. Look again at what slipped through.
ranks.line_zh: 大部分都抓到了，漏掉的再看一次。

ranks.line_en: The crew had a good evening. Play again and look for the tells first.
ranks.line_zh: 今晚歹徒賺到了。再玩一次，先找出可疑的地方。

cases.desc_zh: 攻擊者用從空調廠商偷來的帳號密碼進入 Target 網路，再在 POS 上裝記憶體側錄程式；約 4,000 萬張卡和約 7,000 萬名顧客的個資外洩。
cases.lesson_zh: 限制並監控廠商存取、隔離刷卡網路、告警要有人處理。
cases.desc_en: Attackers used login details stolen from an HVAC contractor to get into Target's network, then installed memory-scraping malware on POS systems; about 40 million card accounts and the personal data of about 70 million customers were exposed.
cases.lesson_en: Limit and monitor vendor access, separate the payment network, and act on alerts.

cases.desc_zh: 攻擊者在 LinkedIn 找到一名員工，打給服務台假冒他、取得重設後的權限；接下來的攻擊讓飯店和賭場系統（包括數位房卡和吃角子老虎機）停擺約十天，估計損失約 1 億美元。
cases.lesson_zh: 任何重設前都要核實來電者，特權帳號用防釣魚的多因素驗證，並準備人工替代方案。
cases.desc_en: Attackers found an employee on LinkedIn, called the IT help desk pretending to be that person and had access reset; the attack that followed disrupted hotel and casino systems, including digital room keys and slot machines, for about ten days, with an estimated impact of about US$100 million.
cases.lesson_en: Verify callers before any reset, use phishing-resistant MFA for privileged accounts, and prepare manual fallbacks.

queries.purpose: phishing warning signs and their weights
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:PhishingSign) RETURN p.key AS key, p.name_en AS en, p.name_zh AS zh, p.desc_en AS d_en, p.desc_zh AS d_zh, p.weight AS w ORDER BY w DESC, key
MATCH (p:Procedure {key: $k}) RETURN p {.key, .name_en, .name_zh, .time_en, .time_zh, .dont_en, .dont_zh} AS p, [(p)-[:HAS_STEP]->(s) | s {.order, .phase, .who, .text_en, .text_zh}] AS steps
MATCH (p:Procedure {key: $k}) RETURN p {.key, .name_en, .name_zh, .time_en, .time_zh, .dont_en, .dont_zh} AS p, [(p)-[:HAS_STEP]->(s) | s {.order, .phase, .who, .text_en, .text_zh}] AS steps
MATCH (p:Procedure {key: $k}) RETURN p {.key, .name_en, .name_zh, .time_en, .time_zh, .dont_en, .dont_zh} AS p, [(p)-[:HAS_STEP]->(s) | s {.order, .phase, .who, .text_en, .text_zh}] AS steps
MATCH (p:Procedure {key: $k}) RETURN p {.key, .name_en, .name_zh, .time_en, .time_zh, .dont_en, .dont_zh} AS p, [(p)-[:HAS_STEP]->(s) | s {.order, .phase, .who, .text_en, .text_zh}] AS steps
UNWIND $keys AS k MATCH (n:Entity {key: k}) RETURN n {.key, .name_en, .name_zh, .desc_en, .desc_zh, .lesson_en, .lesson_zh, .notice_en, .notice_zh, .classification, .year} AS n
